name: Berghof Thöni
beschreibung: Berghof Thöni is set amidst the breathtaking Tyrolean mountain scenery, blending traditional alpine charm with cozy comfort. As a traditional inn, it features an authentic regional kitchen focusing on seasonal delicacies and locally harvested produce. The guest rooms are comfortably and practically appointed, inviting guests to unwind and relax after scenic hikes or ski tours. Its prime location is ideal for outdoor adventures in the surrounding alpine landscape during both summer and winter. Heartfelt family hospitality and a relaxed atmosphere make every stay truly special.
